readerCopy.body: The urge to break a rule gets stronger when the rule keeps blocking a choice that no longer feels optional. When Uranus squares Lilith, disruption and refusal create friction, making compromise feel increasingly pointless when every compromise preserves the same restriction. What has been tolerated becomes harder to keep tolerating when nothing meaningful changes. If you feel the urge to reject the whole arrangement, it may help to separate the rule that no longer works from the support that still does. Change has more staying power when it removes the actual restriction instead of treating disruption itself as proof of freedom.
